feed.title: Daily Data Lab
feed.subtitle: One small interactive data visualization a day, built with React and public data.

entry.title: Day 006: Where is the world's food wasted, and by whom?
entry.summary: UNEP's 1.05 billion tonnes of food wasted in 2022, split into homes, restaurants, and shops for the 100 most populous countries, set against hunger, income, and climate, with Mexico and the United States side by side.

entry.title: Day 005: Which languages are endangered and barely documented?
entry.summary: All 7,685 spoken first languages in Glottolog 5.4, mapped by how endangered they are and how well they are described, with the families and countries most at risk and the gaps in the world's grammar databases.

entry.title: Day 004: How fast are winters warming at Abraham Lake?
entry.summary: The Alberta reservoir famous for methane bubbles frozen in its ice, set against 1.43 million lakes in HydroLAKES and 75 winters of ERA5 air temperature, with the warming trend of the world's largest lakes, growing every day.

entry.title: Day 003: Where and when do light pillars appear?
entry.summary: An atlas of photographed light pillars, sun dogs, and ice halos from 2000 to 2026, with the weather at each moment and a 3-D simulator of the ice crystals that turn a light into a column.

entry.title: Day 002: Where do New Zealand's glowworms shine?
entry.summary: Every public record of the Waitomo glowworm on a night-sky map of New Zealand, set against the weather outside the caves where the larvae light up the ceilings.

entry.title: Day 001: When is the best time to cross from Mexicali?
entry.summary: Live and historical wait times at the Calexico ports of entry, with the best and worst hours to cross by day of the week.
